name: Local Document I/O
purpose: Read, write, edit, and append UTF-8 text documents on the local machine (one operation per invocation), with atomic writes, EOL preservation, sha256 reporting, an optional expect_sha256 precondition, and a recoverable pre-image.

invocation.args_spec: -Op read|write|edit|append -Path <file> [op-specific] | -InputsJson '<json>'. Opt-in doc lease (res.lease #29, write/edit/append): -Lease [-LeaseWaitSeconds <n>] [-LeaseTtlSeconds <n>] [-LeaseHolder <id>] [-LeaseResource <name>] [-LeaseDir <dir>] [-ResLeasePath <path>] [-PwshPath <path>] (InputsJson: lease, lease_wait_s, lease_ttl_s, lease_holder, lease_resource, lease_dir, res_lease_path, pwsh_path).

inputs.name: op
inputs.description: Operation: read | write | edit | append.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Target document path (absolute, or relative to CWD).

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: New content (required for write and append).

inputs.name: old_string
inputs.description: Exact string to find (required for edit).

inputs.name: new_string
inputs.description: Replacement string (required for edit).

inputs.name: replace_all
inputs.description: edit: replace every occurrence (else exactly one required).

inputs.name: expect_count
inputs.description: edit: require exactly this many occurrences.

inputs.name: start_line
inputs.description: read: 1-indexed inclusive range start.

inputs.name: end_line
inputs.description: read: 1-indexed inclusive range end.

inputs.name: max_bytes
inputs.description: read: cap the returned content in bytes.

inputs.name: eol
inputs.description: write/append: newline convention for the written content (lf|crlf).

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.description: write: overwrite an existing file.

inputs.name: create_dirs
inputs.description: write: create missing parent directories.

inputs.name: create
inputs.description: append: create the file if missing.

inputs.name: ensure_newline
inputs.description: append: insert a separating newline when the file does not end with one.

inputs.name: encoding
inputs.description: utf-8 (default) or utf-8-bom; read also auto-detects UTF-16 LE/BE BOM; edit/append preserve the detected encoding.

inputs.name: expect_sha256
inputs.description: write/edit/append: precondition — the current file's sha256 must match.

inputs.name: no_preimage
inputs.description: Disable the before.<ext> pre-image artifact for mutating ops.

inputs.name: lease
inputs.description: write/edit/append: opt-in — acquire the res.lease doc:<relpath> lease around the read-modify-write so concurrent editors of the same file serialize. Graceful (warn + proceed) when res.lease is absent/disabled; released after the atomic write. Errors doc_lease_unavailable (retryable) if held by another and not acquired within lease_wait_s.

inputs.name: lease_wait_s
inputs.description: Blocking wait budget for the doc lease.

inputs.name: lease_ttl_s
inputs.description: Doc-lease TTL seconds.

inputs.name: lease_holder
inputs.description: Stable holder id; default $env:LIFEORCH_INSTANCE else doc.io:<pid>.

inputs.name: lease_resource
inputs.description: Override the auto-derived doc:<relpath> resource name (all coordinators must agree on the name for the same file).

inputs.name: lease_dir
inputs.description: Shared lease dir passthrough to res.lease.

inputs.name: res_lease_path
inputs.description: Override path to Invoke-ResLease.ps1 (default: auto-resolve via repo root / sibling module).

inputs.name: pwsh_path
inputs.description: pwsh used to spawn res.lease as a child process (default: resolve via PATH).

outputs.description: {op, path, existed, file{encoding,bom,eol,line_count,byte_count,char_count,sha256}, and op-specific fields (read: content/returned; write/edit/append: sha256_before/counts/preimage). When -Lease is used, write/edit/append also include lease{enabled,resource,available,acquired,owned,already_held,lease_id,held_by,released}}.
